scope: constant traceless Hermitian four-matrix bodies; identity links; untwisted AP grid. Reduction all even N>=4; exact minimizer enclosures and certified interiority ONLY N4/6/8.
derivation: Native neutral h(k)=M(k)Phi0+sum_i D_i(k)Phi_i. Set x_mu=Tr(Phi_mu^2)/4>=0. Complete canonical2V KyFan <= Tr h_positive = (1/2)Tr|h_total| because Tr h_total=0. This is an upper, not a generic canonical occupation identity.

Reflect each AP momentum component k_i -> -k_i. M and D_i^2 unchanged while each D_i changes sign. In each eight-reflection group, cross traces cancel: mean Tr h(k)^2=4[M^2 x0+sum_i D_i^2 xi]. Schatten Cauchy Tr|h|<=2sqrt(Tr h^2), then concavity of sqrt imply reflection mean Tr|h|<=4sqrt(M^2x0+sum D_i^2xi).
Ordered Jordan per site=4sum_mu,nu Tr{Phi_mu,Phi_nu}^2 >=16sum_mu Tr Phi_mu^4 >=64sum_mu x_mu^2. Cross terms nonnegative; diagonal Schatten inequality uses matrix dimension4.

For Phi_mu=sqrt(x_mu)Gamma_mu with four anticommuting traceless Hermitian Clifford matrices, Phi_mu^2=x_mu I, all off-diagonal anticommutators vanish and h(k)^2=(M^2x0+sum D_i^2xi)I. Spectrum +/-epsilon twice yields exactly2V positive states. Clifford matrices simultaneously saturate Jordan and the complete canonical bound. Thus inf over all uniform matrices equals min_{x>=0} f(x)=64sum x_mu^2-2mean_k sqrt(M^2x0+sum D_i^2xi).

f is coercive and128-strongly convex on the nonnegative orthant, with Hessian 128I plus a PSD sum in the differentiable interior. The unique minimizer here refers to its norm-square vector, not a unique matrix frame/orbit. Spatial S3 symmetry implies x1=x2=x3.

At any positive rational candidate x, strong convexity gives f(x)-f*<=||grad f(x)||^2/256 and distance(x,x*)^2<=||grad f(x)||^2/128^2 even if the constrained minimizer were on the boundary. Exact384-bit outward rational intervals on sqrt/AP trig and gradients enclose these quantities; the FLOAT optimizer is not rerun and provides only candidate binary-rational inputs.

NONZERO COEFFICIENTS ALONE DO NOT PROVE INTERIORITY: the original receipt supporting sentence is withdrawn. For N4/6/8 the exact distance-square bound is strictly below min_mu x_mu^2, independently establishing interiority. No untested all-N interior assertion is used.
